spec.userPrompt:
QUESTION PROMPT: Conjuguez au plus-que-parfait dans la construction « à peine…que ».

CORRECT ANSWER: avait démarré

Is this correct answer grammatically valid French?

responses.raw:
VERDICT: VALID
REASON: "avait démarré" is the correct plus-que-parfait form of the verb "démarrer" (to start). It uses the auxiliary "avoir" in the imparfait ("avait") + past participle ("démarré"), which is the proper conjugation for this tense. In the "à peine...que" construction, this indicates an action that had just completed, e.g., "À peine avait-il démarré que..." (He had barely started when...). This is standard, grammatically correct French.
